note: Prompt set B for the Kandinsky 6 quality gate. Disjoint from set A and built to the same category coverage (face, text, motion, speech/sharp-sound), so a recipe that passes A can be checked against a second set it was not tuned on. The vault's c-qwen-image21-fp8-quality-is-prompt-dependent-2026-09 records an FP8 recipe that passed one 8-prompt set at LPIPS 0.034 and failed a second at 0.162: one set is not evidence.

prompts.text: A news anchor in a dark suit reads to camera in a studio; a lower-third graphic clearly displays the word LIVE in white capitals on red. Even key lighting, shallow background bokeh. Audio: a steady male voice reading, faint studio air handling.

A woman in a crowded Marrakesh spice market gestures and talks animatedly to a vendor, saffron and paprika piled in cones around them, dappled sunlight through canvas. Audio: an energetic female voice speaking, overlapping market chatter, a distant moped.

Camera dollies slowly left past a vintage American diner front at dusk; the window decal clearly reads EAT in bold black capitals. Chrome trim, pink and blue sky. Audio: passing car tyres on wet asphalt, a jukebox muffled behind glass, a bell on the door.

A tennis player serves at full stretch on a blue hard court, shot from behind the baseline at high shutter speed, ball compressing on the strings, his face grimacing. Audio: a sharp racket-on-ball pop, squeaking shoes, a brief crowd murmur.

A glassblower rotates a glowing molten gather on a blowpipe in a dim workshop, orange light on her concentrated face, tools resting nearby. Audio: a roaring furnace, hissing as the glass meets wet newspaper, quiet scraping.

An express train rushes through a rural station without stopping, camera locked off on the platform; the station board clearly reads WEST in black capitals. Leaves whip up in the slipstream. Audio: a rising roar then doppler drop, a sharp horn blast, rattling signage.

A small girl in a paper hat blows out five candles on a chocolate cake in a warm kitchen, her cheeks puffed, relatives leaning in around her. Audio: a sharp collective cheer, a party horn, clapping, then laughter.

A surfer drops into a large barrelling wave shot from the water at dawn, spray feathering off the lip, low golden light through the curl. Audio: a heavy churning wave, rushing water, wind across the microphone.

An elderly piano tuner leans over an open grand piano in a quiet parlour, strikes one key repeatedly, listens, then mutters to himself. Audio: a single piano note struck several times, a tuning lever creak, a low muttering male voice.
